title: JS hooks use .js- class; data-* stores data, never behavior bindings
trigger: JS querySelector/closest chọn element để bind behavior
principle: Bind behavior via .js-<role> class; store payload via data-* attributes, read with getAttribute. A selector may use .js- class as hook and [data-*] as a value filter, but data-* alone must never be the behavior hook — that couples DOM data to JS targeting and breaks when the attribute is refactored.

cases.context: JS tìm panel đang mở để replace — cần hook (bind) + payload filter (audio vs image)
JS detect click outside popup, skip if click trên subtitle token
